rationale: The migration updated the dependency but left source calls using the old Octokit namespace, so @actions/github v5 exposes methods under rest while the code still calls octokit.repos and octokit.issues. The trajectory shows TypeScript diagnostics for the missing repos/issues properties, and the verifier failed at runtime with listReleases undefined after the test patch exercised the v5 API shape. This is a concrete source/API namespace inconsistency rather than an installation or infrastructure failure.
